title: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
title_original: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 9 (Payment of Joint Fund)
(1) The Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants shall, in accordance with Article 33 of the Act, pay the joint fund to a company or third party as specified in Article 31(1) and (2) of the Act, from the date of application to the last day of the following month.
(2) When the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants pays the joint fund as stipulated in (1), it shall report this fact to the Financial Supervisory Commission.
